blocks.title: Erotic / Sexual Tension Progression
blocks.body: E07 ke lace-bra video cliffhanger ka immediate shock E08 mein stitched-fabric illusion nikalta hai, actual bare exposure nahi. P2–P3 emotional apology aur teacher-reputation worry foreground par aate hain. P4–P6 mein Bantu ke saath deliberate gaze aur clothing boundary ki takkar hai; P7 mein accidental foot brush ke baad intentional second contact materially different hai. Later P9–P12 mein Bobby remote route aur towel coverage se nayi vulnerability aur uncertainty nikalti hai. Yeh source ke adult arousal/curiosity ka record hai, blanket consent nahi.

blocks.title: Reader-Known Secrets & Dramatic Irony
blocks.body: E07 end par Dhika aur twins ka view mismatch reader ko mystery deta hai; P1–P2 stitching reveal ke baad pata chalta hai ki real nipples nazar nahi aaye. Bantu pehle unhe real maan baitha tha aur personal visit mein clarification paata hai; Bobby ko same detailed clarification direct batayi gayi, aisa source explicitly nahi kehta. P4–P5 Dhika ko apni curiosity khud accept karna mushkil hai lekin Bantu uski nazar observe kar leta hai. P9 Bobby camera par jo samajhta hai woh Dhika ki original expectation se alag hai. John ki knowledge absent; Chotu ke E06 aftermath ka sach uski private comparison se overwrite nahi hota.

blocks.title: Major Turning Points & Why They Matter
blocks.body: P1 L12–13: stitched illusion is the explanation for prior episode's visual cliffhanger. P2 L27–37: Bantu in-person visit shifts hostility into apology and a narrow visual clarification. P3 L42–55: teacher boundary and risk become explicit while Switzerland mentor hook is planted. P6 L116–121: look-only game crosses into Bantu's physical shirt manipulation. P7 L136–140: accidental leg contact and Bantu's deliberate repetition split the encounter into separate consent facts. P9–P10 L157–185: independent Bobby video route creates a new type of observed coverage. P12 L198–210: mangalsutra clarification defuses a misunderstanding, then a different unresolved surprise ends E08.

blocks.title: Open Hooks / Unresolved Questions
blocks.body: Bobby's final shocked blush ka exact trigger kya hai? E08 L210 mein action intentionally omitted hai; E09 se backwards import nahi karna. Kya twins Swiss competition jeetenge aur mentor kaun banega? Kya Dhika John ke bina trip manage karna chaahegi? Chotu E06 ke baad genuinely kya mehsoos karta hai—E07 ki doori aur E08 absence se confirm nahi hota. Dhika teacher/public reputation ka darr aage decisions ko kaise affect karega? Bantu ke physical boundary crossing ke baad future understanding clear hogi ya nahi? Source E08 in sawalon ka jawab nahi deta.

blocks.title: Reader Possibilities — NON-CANON
blocks.body: Sirf source-grounded possibilities: E08 L209 explicitly kehta hai Bobby bra ko haath mein dikhane ki expected gesture soch raha tha, Dhika kuch alag karti hai; exact next gesture E08 mein describe nahi hua. Swiss travel preference Bantu report karta hai, but win and actual attendance future-dependent. Chotu ka continued distance aur John ignorance conflict ke possible future conversation points hain, not established outcomes. Koi naya sexual act, exposure ya consent invent nahi karna.

blocks.title: Episode-End Reader Carry-Forward
blocks.body: E08 ka final verified beat: Bobby mangalsutra dikhane ko towel thoda lower maangta hai, Dhika bare-exposure concern ke saath reject karti hai, clarification se relieved hoti hai, bra pehenne ki baat rakhti hai aur Bobby ke pehle dekhne wale sawaal par wink karke nod karti hai. Uske baad exact Dhika action source nahi batata; sirf Bobby ke strong blush ka narrator foreshadowing hai. Bantu visit aur Chotu's unresolved history alag states mein locked rahte hain.
